environment.description: Application deployed in EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) with the pod running under a dedicated ServiceAccount. The pod spec includes a Seccomp profile of type RuntimeDefault AND an AppArmor annotation (container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/report-svc=runtime/default). The container image is distroless (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12) with no shell binary (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, /bin/dash are absent). The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy for the namespace restricts egress to only the RDS endpoint on port 5432 and the kube-dns service on port 53. Additionally, the OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockWildcardIngress' is active but is not directly relevant. The pod's SecurityContext sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true with only /tmp mounted as an emptyDir.
